description: Searches recent regulatory filings (full-text) for a company, ticker, or theme (e.g. 'bitcoin treasury'). Returns the most recent matching filings with form type, filer, and a direct document link.

query.description: Free-text query, e.g. a company name, ticker, or theme.

name: filings_search

filings.description: Most recent matching filings, up to 15; empty when none

url.description: Direct link to the filing document; absent when unknown

title: Regulatory Filings Search
